test_policy.notes: MSU is test-optional: first-year applicants may apply without SAT or ACT scores, for admission and scholarships. SAT/ACT can still be used to show English proficiency.

requirements.notes: Apply through the MSU application, Common App or Coalition with Scoir (no preference; submit only one). Early action must be selected on the application to get the Jan 15 decision.

deadlines.label: Early action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision guaranteed by Jan 15 and automatic maximum scholarship consideration.

deadlines.label: Regular decision priority date
deadlines.notes: Complete applications by Feb 1 are guaranteed an initial decision by March 31.

deadlines.label: Regular decision final deadline
deadlines.notes: Applications between Feb 1 and Apr 1 are reviewed on a rolling basis while space remains.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required if you are a US citizen/permanent resident or English is your first language. Also met by SAT (EBRW 510+ with total 1110+), ACT (English 18+ with composite 23+), AP English Language 4+, IB English A 5+, IGCSE/GCSE/A-level English results, 3 years of US high school with GPA 3.0+, or a year at a US university. A provisional-admission band exists below the regular minimums.

english.notes: Exams taken before 2026-01-21. Provisional admission at 60-78. MyBest superscores not accepted.
Exams taken on or after 2026-01-21; speaking may be 3.5. Provisional admission at 3.5.
Provisional admission at 6.0. IELTS Indicator also accepted at 6.5.
Provisional admission at an overall 46 or higher.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for aid through FAFSA. All admitted international students are automatically considered for the MSU Non-resident Scholarship ($3,000 to $18,000 a year, award levels by academic performance; decisions by mid-February); applying by Nov 1 gives maximum consideration.

tier_notes.business: Supply chain management is ranked #1; Broad College overall is top-30.
